info.title: Cpnucleo Web API
info.description: Authenticated REST API for Cpnucleo project, workflow, assignment, organization, and user management.

patch.description: Updates the workflow identified by the provided Id with new given data. Validates existence and returns whether the update was successful.

delete.description: Deletes the workflows specified by the provided Ids. Validates existence of each, removes them, updates the repository, and commits the transaction.

404.description: An id is missing or not visible; nothing was removed.

409.description: A record still has active dependent data; nothing was removed.

get.description: Fetches the workflow matching the provided Id. Returns 404 if not found, otherwise returns the workflow data mapped to a DTO.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier for the workflow.

post.description: Creates a new workflow record with the given data and custom Id. Validates uniqueness and returns the created workflow's data.
Undoes the soft delete of the workflows specified by the provided Ids in one transaction. If any id is missing, still active or not visible, nothing is restored.

404.description: An id is missing, active or not visible; nothing was restored.

get.summary: Retrieve a paginated list of workflows
get.description: Fetches workflows based on pagination parameters, maps entities to DTOs, and returns paginated results with metadata (total count, page number, and page size).

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text search; wildcard characters match literally.

parameters.name: sortColumn
parameters.description: A persisted property of the listed record.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated UUIDs (at most 100) restricting the result.

404.description: An id is missing or not visible; nothing was removed.

409.description: A record still has active dependent data; nothing was removed.

get.description: Fetches the project matching the provided Id. Returns 404 if not found, otherwise returns the project data mapped to a DTO.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier for the project.

post.description: Creates a new project record with the given data and custom Id. Validates uniqueness and returns the created project's data.
All supplied removed projects are restored in one transaction, with the memberships removed together with them. A missing, active or invisible project leaves the whole batch unchanged.

patch.summary: Change the signed-in user's display name
patch.description: Updates only the display name of the token's subject. The login, password and other accounts can't be changed here.

get.description: Returns the account of the token's subject. Any signed-in user (or service account) may call it; a subject without an active account is 404.

post.description: Verifies the current password and stores the new one. Existing tokens and sessions of the account stop working, so the client signs in again. Five wrong current passwords in 15 minutes lock password changes for 15 minutes (429 with Retry-After).

429.description: Too many incorrect current passwords; Retry-After gives the seconds to wait.
